text_simplified: The Prophet ﷺ informed us that Allah says: My believing servant has no reward with Me when I take his beloved one from the people of the world and he patiently seeks reward, except Paradise. Parents who lose a child and are patient and seek Allah's reward enter into this. The author conveyed Shaykh Ibn Baz's response that kindness to daughters is not limited to providing food, drink, and clothing, but encompasses raising them with Islamic tarbiyah, teaching them, and safeguarding their chastity.
